_comment: Corrected policy. Four constraints applied simultaneously: (1) actions enumerated rather than wildcarded, (2) resources scoped to the single bucket and prefix the WAF actually needs, (3) an explicit deny on any other S3 action so that a later policy merge cannot silently widen access, (4) the deny is expressed with NotAction so newly introduced S3 actions are denied by default rather than permitted. A WAF needs its own rule files; it has no functional requirement to read customer data.
